description.fun: A jungle monkey that lives in a pack and is so aggressive that the other Pokémon of the forest fear it. It grows vines from its wrists, neck and feet to swing through the trees, grab food from afar and even heal its wounds, and vines that tear off become nutrients that help the forest grow. It's the only Mythical Pokémon introduced in Generation VIII.
description.guide: A Dark and Grass-type Mythical Pokémon introduced in The Isle of Armor and the star of the film Secrets of the Jungle. A Zarude known as Dada, who raised a human child, has its own form.
description.tagline: A vine-swinging jungle monkey the forest fears

description.fun: This Zarude left its pack to raise Koko, an orphaned human child, from infancy, and wears a ripped pink cape. Its special strength comes from its love for the child, as seen in the film Secrets of the Jungle.
